bullets: Fixed chat resume to rank saved files correctly so the --continue flag no longer picks the empty log folder from the current launch.
Updated the subscription disclaimer to state that daily hours reset at midnight in your local timezone, matching the free-tier behavior.
Raised the automatic context window cap for Bring Your Own Key models from 400,000 to 2,000,000 tokens.
Added a context window mode option for Bring Your Own Key connections, allowing you to choose between auto-detection or manual limits.
Renamed the lowest reasoning effort label from Fast to Instant across model presets and hover hints.
Added a new minimal reasoning effort option for DeepSeek V4 models, which disables the internal thinking process entirely.
Updated the terminal assistant to show plain-English reasoning effort labels only when a model offers multiple levels, hiding them for single-level models.
Removed the hand-picked featured section from the template gallery, which now displays only the All view and category filters.
Added a static snapshot of template usage counts so tiles display their selection count when the total reaches at least 25 picks.
Updated the community feed label for the projects browsing category to display as Tools instead of Projects.
Added optional role fields to shared chat contracts to distinguish between viewer and editor permissions for teammates.
Updated the terminal chat header to hide the status panel when no data is available and moved the data-use disclosure to the bottom.
Added model-generated titles for terminal chats on the first message, matching the desktop application's behavior.
Updated the sponsored consent card to display a single disclosure stating that edits are local, commits are not made, and undo is available.
Added a security check to the chat resume feature that blocks attempts to access folders outside your saved chats directory.
Updated the assistant to search for external services more frequently by unifying the look-it-up-early directive across all interfaces.
Updated the Gravity Index link interface to display the selected service's name and description alongside the button.
Removed inline report buttons from advertisements and sponsored tasks in the terminal interface.
Prevented visible console windows from flashing on screen when running background tasks on Windows operating systems.
